note: Corps campground on a wooded plateau above Dale Hollow Lake, beside the concession-run Willow Grove Marina at the end of Willow Grove Road; the agency advises not relying on GPS alone to find it. Sites 13-15 sit just above the shore; most others look at the lake through trees. Gates close 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. The loop 1 shower house (sites 1-16) was closed for maintenance as of November 2026. --Claude
summary: USACE Willow Grove confirmed: 59 water/electric 50 A sites + 21 tent-only + group, no sewer, $36 (confirmed), 2027 season May 21 - Sep 6 (2026 May 15 - Sep 7), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, showers, laundry, wifi, dump; max_rig 42 (derived) -> 81 (catalog). Lakefront kept on sites 13-15 only; the NW rows are ~13 m above the lake behind woods.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, but only on sites 13, 14, 15 (36.58842,-85.34218 / 36.58839,-85.34253 / 36.58831,-85.34285; recreation.gov tags these three 'Lakefront'; water/electric, sold nightly, reservable, $36): 3DEP pads 201.2-203.0 m vs Dale Hollow summer pool 651 ft (198.4 m), the pool contour ~19-25 m in front down a ~7-13 degree grassy bank under scattered trees; the site 15 photo shows the lake right behind the pad. The stored evidence's 'herringbone pads ... open apron' does not hold for the NW plateau rows: sites 29-49 are 211-214 m, ~13 m above pool and 40-57 m from it through a wooded bank (photos of 44-46: lake through trees) = lakeview. Only three sites carry the lakefront value; reviewer may prefer lakeview.
